correctness.rationale: The geometric factorization reduces each endpoint norm with a uniform O(1) error to a logarithmically weighted almost-periodic mean. Kronecker mean for irrational alpha and absolutely uniform cosine series with nq=mp resonances for reduced rational p/q establish the claimed formula. Positive terms for even q and a strictly alternating series for odd q prove parity. Termwise maximality of p/q=3/2 and the strict 20/945 > 1/105 deficit comparison prove global unique extrema; two elementary split integrals yield exact radicals. Continuity uses growing denominators of rational approximants to each irrational. Standalone check.py passed 30 supplementary checks; limits do not rely on numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: The first disconnected two-equal-block Fourier projector has a nontrivial interference pattern invisible to the single-block Lebesgue constant. An exact coefficient for every real gap ratio, sign change by reduced-denominator parity, a precisely characterized discontinuity set, and two unique global optimizing gaps provide an informative structural classification. A known general existence-of-almost-periodic-mean statement would not itself provide these sharp arithmetic and optimization conclusions.
